_comment: FROZEN known-debt baseline for the cloud-ci-tier-dependency-acyclicity gate (Phase-0 capability-first reorg; ADR-0245/0280/0562). The set of PRE-EXISTING tier-dependency violations captured on the live tree at the gate's birth — the substrate-inversions the reorg exists to fix (substrate->product upward edges + intra-substrate S-rank inversions). The gate reports these ADVISORY-only and blocks ONLY on a NEW regression (a code|subject NOT in this set). The baseline BURNS DOWN as the strangler moves fix inversions; removing an entry is always allowed. When violations reaches zero, flip the policy enforcement to "blocking". DATA, not code: canonical-json governed. Each entry's `code|subject` is the membership identity; subject is the crate edge `from -> to`. Regenerate via `oya-cloud-ci-tier-dependency-acyclicity --repo-root . --emit-baseline`.
